Para ti, que quieres entender las pruebas de programas con AI y le pides que modifique código: dejamos registros reproducibles de la aceptación de entradas válidas y de la terminación.

El 2026-10-22, Anthropic y Theorem publicaron su investigación conjunta. El informe abarca 239 puntos de entrada de 123 bibliotecas; la versión pública citada aquí abarca 60 puntos de entrada de 25 bibliotecas. Solo esa versión pública carece de pruebas de la proposición halts; no extrapolamos al estudio completo.

Nuestro control de aceptación original y local limita n a 0..255, con capacidad de 8 bytes y 1 byte adicional para el terminador; solo decide si aceptar. Otro programa independiente comprueba el retorno tras contar. Usamos ejecuciones reales en C, enumeración exhaustiva, SAT proposicional para el control y un grafo de control finito para el bucle. No ejecutamos el verificador Rocq del proveedor.

Código C original, resultados de ejecución y paquete completo de fuentes: https://github.com/x812033727/travel_scanner/tree/9c65d31a80ac9622676db460c9ed3d52716b6496/docs/videos/claude-formal-verification-255/data

id.verdict: ready after listed semantic/clarity fixes and remaining budget blockers are resolved

critical_source_checks: 0..255 domain; 8-byte capacity with 1 terminator byte inside it; acceptance iff 0..7.
255+1 is int 256 after promotion, then unsigned 8-bit narrowing stores 0; bits differ from bytes.
Wide calculation/casts and total storage both preserve the full value; widening after narrowing cannot recover 256.
Only widened guard has no counterexample in both SAT directions; reject-all is symbolic, not another compiled C run.
Guard only decides Boolean acceptance; no buffer write.
Counter is independent, fixed limit, no other counter writer; 0.25-second timeout alone is not proof; finite 256-step cycle gives the reason.
Counter declaration and update cast are both fixed to unsigned 16-bit; every input exits and returns limit+1.
Rocq kernel checks AI-written proofs at compilation, tool checks fixed statement and lists used assumptions, then allowlist audit.

Public proof compares normal and error-checked builds of same program; premise concerns normal-build specified memory budget in system model. Both exclude specified errors and have equal allowed observable finite-trace sets.
No halts proof conclusion applies only to this public release. Study 123 libraries/239 entries vs public 60 entries/25 libraries retained.
Local actual C comparisons are not Rocq reproduction or certification of the entire application.
Product names, dates, full pinned URL and original-SVG provenance preserved; no invented Chinese pronunciations.
candidate_use_note: Fitting candidates are reviewer proposals, not applied translations or proof of actual audio fit. Unresolved rows retain all source constraints in the proposed full wording. No max_chars was edited. Contextual pronouns and ordinary full-word equivalents are used; no word fragments or Chinese pronunciation substitutions.
